# Data Preparation and Version Control


## 1\. Library Import and Data Loading

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(recipes)
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv("df_final.csv") %>% clean_names()

cat("Loaded df_final. Rows:", nrow(df), "Cols:", ncol(df), "\n")
```

## 2\. Identify Variable Roles and Define Generator Function


```{r}
target <- "training_power_draw_w"
log_vars <- c("parameters", target)

numeric_vars <- df %>%
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  select(-all_of(target)) %>%
  names()

categorical_vars <- df %>%
  select(where(is.character), where(is.factor)) %>%
  names()
```

```{r}

make_version <- function(data, log = FALSE, scale = FALSE, ohe = FALSE,
                         interactions = FALSE, remove_outliers = FALSE, version_name) {
  
  if (remove_outliers) {
    num_vars <- c(numeric_vars, log_vars)
    for (v in num_vars) {
      Q1 <- quantile(data[[v]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
      Q3 <- quantile(data[[v]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
      IQR <- Q3 - Q1
      data <- data %>% filter(data[[v]] >= (Q1 - 1.5*IQR) & data[[v]] <= (Q3 + 1.5*IQR))
    }
  }
  
  recipe_obj <- recipe(as.formula(paste(target, "~ .")), data = data)
  
  # LOG TRANSFORMATION
  if (log) {
    recipe_obj <- recipe_obj %>%
      step_log(all_of(log_vars), offset = 1)
  }
  
  # ONE-HOT ENCODING
  if (ohe) {
    recipe_obj <- recipe_obj %>%
      step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors(), one_hot = TRUE)
  }
  
  if (scale) {
    recipe_obj <- recipe_obj %>%
      step_center(all_numeric_predictors(), -all_outcomes(), -matches("^.*_")) %>%
      step_scale(all_numeric_predictors(), -all_outcomes(), -matches("^.*_"))
  }
  
  if (interactions) {
    vars_to_interact <- intersect(c("parameters", "days_since_first"), colnames(data))
    
    if (length(vars_to_interact) == 2) {
      interaction_formula <- as.formula(paste("~", paste(vars_to_interact, collapse = ":")))
      recipe_obj <- recipe_obj %>%
        step_interact(terms = interaction_formula)
    }
  }
  
  final <- prep(recipe_obj, training = data) %>% bake(new_data = NULL)
  
  write.csv(final, paste0(version_name, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("Saved", version_name, "\n")
  return(final)
}
```

## 3\. Create All Data Versions (V1 - V11)


```{r}
V1 <- make_version(df, log=FALSE, scale=FALSE, ohe=FALSE, interactions=FALSE, remove_outliers = FALSE, version_name="V1_clean")

V2 <- make_version(df, log=TRUE,  scale=FALSE, ohe=FALSE, interactions=FALSE, remove_outliers = FALSE, version_name="V2_log")

V3 <- make_version(df, log=FALSE, scale=TRUE,  ohe=FALSE, interactions=FALSE, remove_outliers = FALSE,version_name="V3_scaled")

V4 <- make_version(df, log=FALSE, scale=FALSE, ohe=TRUE,  interactions=FALSE, remove_outliers = FALSE,version_name="V4_onehot")

V5 <- make_version(df, log=TRUE,  scale=TRUE,  ohe=FALSE, interactions=FALSE, remove_outliers = FALSE, version_name="V5_log_scaled")

V6 <- make_version(df, log=TRUE,  scale=FALSE, ohe=TRUE,  interactions=FALSE, remove_outliers = FALSE, version_name="V6_log_onehot")

V7 <- make_version(df, log=FALSE, scale=TRUE,  ohe=TRUE, interactions=FALSE, remove_outliers = FALSE, version_name="V7_scaled_onehot")

V8 <- make_version(df, log=TRUE,  scale=TRUE,  ohe=TRUE, interactions=FALSE, remove_outliers = FALSE, version_name="V8_log_scaled_onehot")

V9 <- make_version(df, log=TRUE,  scale=TRUE,  ohe=TRUE, interactions=FALSE, remove_outliers = TRUE, version_name="V9_log_scaled_onehot_outlier")

V10 <- make_version(df, log=TRUE,  scale=TRUE,  ohe=TRUE, interactions=TRUE, remove_outliers = TRUE, version_name="V10_log_scaled_onehot_outlier_interaction")

V10 <- V10 %>%
  select(-matches("parameters"), -matches("days_since_first"))

write.csv(V10, paste0("V10_log_scaled_onehot_outlier_interaction", ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

## 4\. Create V11: Selected Features Version


```{r}
df_select <- df %>%
  select(parameters, num_authors, days_since_first, continent, domain_grouped, training_power_draw_w)

V11 <- make_version(df_select, log=TRUE,  scale=TRUE,  ohe=TRUE, interactions=FALSE, remove_outliers = FALSE, version_name="V11_log_scaled_onehot_feature")

outlier_filter <- function(data, v) {
  Q1 <- quantile(data[[v]], 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
  Q3 <- quantile(data[[v]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
  IQR_val <- Q3 - Q1
  
  data %>%
    filter(data[[v]] >= (Q1 - 1.5 * IQR_val) & data[[v]] <= (Q3 + 1.5 * IQR_val))
}

for (v in c("parameters", "num_authors", "days_since_first")) {
  log_v <- paste0("log_10_", v)
  if (log_v %in% colnames(V11)) {
    V11 <- outlier_filter(V11, log_v)
  }
}
write.csv(V11, paste0("V11_log_scaled_onehot_outlier_feature", ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```
